application.name: Codec
application.description: Encodes a synthetic camera's frames with holoscan-codec's VideoEncoderOp, decodes them with VideoDecoderOp, checks each decoded frame against the one sent (PSNR, order, timestamps) and the bitrate, and shows the original and the decoded frame side by side on a HoloViz display, in a window or offscreen.

changelog.1.0.0: Initial release: the holoscan-codec demo, with a synthetic source, a PSNR and bitrate report, and a HoloViz display in a window or offscreen.

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU with NVENC and NVDEC
hardware.description: A GPU with the video engines, or Jetson Orin with its V4L2 codec devices; see the module's README.

window.description: Encode and decode 1280x720 frames in real time with H.264 at 8 Mbit/s, showing the original and the decoded frame side by side with the bitrate and PSNR, until the window closes.

offscreen.description: Render 120 frames side by side offscreen with H.265, check every rendered frame, and write the last one to codec_render.ppm.

ci.description: Finite headless check: 60 frames through H.265 at a constant QP of 25, every frame decoded, in order, with its timestamp, at a PSNR of 34 dB or more. (The demo's tests also run H.264 and the offscreen render.)
